description: Agent Travel: submit a delayed or cancelled trip with how it was handled: the disruption with its kind (delay, cancellation, schedule change or missed connection), the segment, when the carrier knew of it, the original departure and the new departure; the carrier’s stated policy with how soon the traveler is told, how far from the original departure a rebooking may leave, the delay from which the traveler may choose a refund, whether a cancellation gives that choice and the policy as stated; each notice sent with when, the channel and whether it mentions rebooking and a refund; each option offered with its id, kind (rebook, refund, credit or voucher), when it was offered and a rebooking’s departure; and the outcome with the choice, when it was recorded, whether it is recorded against the booking and any refund amount. The signed report gives the disruption with the delay worked out, the policy with whether a rebooking is called for and whether a refund choice is due, the notice with when the first went out against the window and what the notices mention, the options offered with each rebooking’s distance from the original departure and whether the choice was presented, and the outcome, and counts them, and names a mishandled disruption: no notice to the traveler, no rebooking offered where the policy calls for one and no refund-versus-rebook choice where the policy entitles the traveler to it; then notice later than the window, a rebooking outside the window, notices that leave out the options and an outcome missing from the booking’s record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No policy, no notices, no options, no departures to work out the delay or no outcome leaves the handling unverified. This reads one disrupted trip’s handling against the carrier’s stated policy: how a failed agent task is reported is wever_failure-notice-check, the uptime and credit terms in an SLA text are wever_sla-evidence-check and a refund route for a failed paid call is wever_refund-path-check. Verdict travel_disruption_mishandled, travel_disruption_partial, travel_disruption_unverified or travel_disruption_handled. POST /api/travel-disruption-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
